contexts.text: Jehovah... does not send evil Angels, but man associates them with himself.
The will takes the understanding into fellowship with itself by influx, not contrariwise.
If truths from the Word in the second degree are taken to it to form it, these truths are falsified...
Every man associates with himself a Spirit who is like the affection of his will and the perception of his understanding thence derived...
The reason that what is received in freedom remains, is that the man's will takes and appropriates it to itself...
As to the natural man, man is like a beast, he takes to himself the image of a beast by his life...
